website.note: Pipeline page lists REYOBIQ (rhenium-186 obisbemeda) for recurrent GBM, leptomeningeal metastases, pediatric brain cancers; 188RNL-BAM (preclinical) for primary/secondary liver cancer; CNSide diagnostic platform.

pipeline.modality: Targeted radiotherapeutic (Rhenium-186 nanoliposome with BMEDA chelation, delivered via convection-enhanced delivery (CED) catheter or intraventricular Ommaya reservoir)
pipeline.target: Local tumor delivery (CNS) — beta radiation to malignant cells
pipeline.license_origin: In-licensed from NanoTx, Corp. (NanoTx License Agreement, March 29, 2020); core platform developed at UTHSCSA / Mays Cancer Center

indications.trial_design: Multicenter, sequential cohort, open-label, volume and dose escalation study via CED catheters; FDA Orphan Drug and Fast Track designations
indications.trial_status: Recruiting (Phase 2 portion ongoing; targeting full Phase 2 enrollment by end of 2026)
key_milestones: Targeting full Phase 2 enrollment end of 2026
$3.0M active NIH/NCI grant supports Phase 2 (up to 55 patients)

indications.trial_design: Multi-center, sequential cohort, open-label, dose escalation via intraventricular Ommaya reservoir; recommended Phase 2 dose 44.1 mCi; MTD 66 mCi
indications.trial_status: Active, not recruiting (enrollment completed end-2024; trial completion announced February 26, 2025; closeout activities ongoing)
key_milestones: Single-dose escalation completed; recommended Phase 2 dose 44.1 mCi
FDA Orphan Drug designations for breast cancer LM (Nov 2023) and lung cancer LM (Mar 2025)

indications.trial_design: Open-label multidose Phase 1/2 study to identify MTD across varying dosing intervals and characterize efficacy of multiple doses; CNSide Test as exploratory endpoint
key_milestones: Cohort 1 dosing initiated (13.2 mCi at 3 intervals)
CPRIT Grant up to $17.6M supports development through Phase 2 (~$15.9M received as of Dec 31, 2025)

indications.indication: Recurrent glioma — retreatment after prior 186RNL therapy
indications.trial_design: Safety, efficacy, and tolerability of repeat 186RNL administration in patients who received prior 186RNL treatment

indications.indication: Pediatric recurrent/refractory/progressive ependymoma and high-grade glioma (HGG)
indications.trial_design: Two-part, single-arm, prospective study in pediatric patients aged 6-21; Phase 1a/b modified 3+3 dose escalation (~24 patients) and Phase 2a (~32 patients: 12 ependymoma, 20 HGG) at RP2D
indications.trial_status: Not yet recruiting (IND #168178 cleared June 25, 2025; first patient enrollment anticipated in 2026)
key_milestones: DoD Award $3.0M (Sept 2024) over 3 years to support pediatric trial

commercial_product.name: CNSide CSF Assay Platform
commercial_product.status: Laboratory-developed test (LDT) for detection/characterization of tumor cells in CSF of LM patients; commercially re-introduced in Texas August 2025; national agreements with UnitedHealthcare and Humana; state licensure in 49 of 50 states by January 2026 (NY pending 2027). Used as exploratory endpoint in ReSPECT-LM multidose. Not a therapeutic pipeline asset.

excluded_preclinical: 188RNL-BAM (Rhenium-188 NanoLiposome Biodegradable Alginate Microsphere) — preclinical investigational device for radioembolization in primary/secondary liver cancer; FDA has classified it as a medical device; not yet in clinical trials.
